skill.name: snowtower-maintainer
skill.description: Maintains SnowTower documentation, README content, and Claude configuration. Use it to audit docs, sync project references, and review agent or pattern definitions.
skill.summary: Keeps SnowTower documentation and Claude configuration aligned with the repository.
skill.author: Database-Tycoon

security_audit.summary: All static detections were reviewed and found to be Markdown formatting or visible local shell examples, not executable code bundled with the skill. The command examples support documentation maintenance and do not show network calls, deletion, credential access, or prompt-injection language.

remediation.suggestion: Label shell snippets as optional local verification steps and ask users before running project commands.

content.value_statement: SnowTower documentation can drift from project files, workflows, and agent definitions. This skill guides audits that keep README, docs, and Claude configuration current.
actual_capabilities: Checks README badges, links, command references, diagrams, and statistics against project files.
Audits Claude skills, agents, patterns, and settings for duplicate or outdated definitions.
Guides synchronization between docs under docs/guide and SnowDDL project configuration.
Provides local health check procedures for project structure, commands, tests, and pre-commit status.
Defines trigger conditions for README, documentation, release, and onboarding maintenance tasks.
limitations: It is tailored to the SnowTower repository and assumes its directory layout exists.
It provides maintenance procedures, not automated edits or guaranteed validation.
It may suggest local commands when the agent environment permits command execution.
It does not validate Snowflake permissions or production database state.

use_cases.title: Refresh README Content
use_cases.description: Update badges, command references, statistics, and links before a release.

use_cases.title: Audit Claude Configuration
use_cases.description: Review skills, agents, patterns, and settings for obsolete or duplicate entries.

use_cases.title: Prepare Contributor Onboarding
use_cases.description: Verify setup guides, management commands, and project structure notes for new contributors.

prompt_templates.title: Check README Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the SnowTower README for stale badges, broken links, and outdated command references. Summarize needed updates.

prompt_templates.title: Sync Documentation With Project State
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare docs under docs/guide with current SnowTower configuration and project scripts. Identify mismatches and suggest exact documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Claude Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the Claude agents and patterns for duplicate purposes, outdated file paths, and missing references. Recommend a consolidation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Release Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full SnowTower documentation readiness review before release. Cover README metrics, workflows, guides, Claude configuration, and onboarding notes.

output_examples.input: Review README accuracy before a release.
output_examples.output: A prioritized maintenance list covering badges, links, command references, metrics, and sections that need updated wording.

output_examples.input: Audit the Claude folder for outdated definitions.
output_examples.output: A concise report of overlapping agents, stale pattern references, and recommended changes grouped by file area.

output_examples.input: Check whether guide documentation matches project commands.
output_examples.output: A comparison summary that names each guide area, the expected source of truth, and the required correction.

best_practices: Run documentation audits after feature changes, release changes, or command changes.
Compare documentation claims against repository files before editing user-facing text.
Keep agent and pattern descriptions focused on current SnowTower capabilities.
anti_patterns: Do not update statistics without checking the current repository state.
Do not keep duplicate agents that describe the same maintenance role.
Do not treat command examples as production deployment validation.

faq.question: What does this skill maintain?
faq.answer: It maintains SnowTower README content, docs, Claude configuration, agent definitions, and pattern references.

faq.question: Does it edit files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance for audits and updates. Actual edits depend on the agent workflow and user request.

faq.question: Can it validate workflow badges?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides checks that compare README badge references with workflow files in the repository.

faq.question: Is it useful outside SnowTower?
faq.answer: It is project-specific. Other repositories may need a separate maintainer skill with their own paths and commands.

faq.question: Does it require command execution?
faq.answer: Some procedures suggest local commands for verification. Users should review commands before running them.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
